limitations: The numeric sequence and its standalone recurrence were already published in OEIS A154244; no separate novelty is asserted for that recurrence.
The finite computations do not prove infinite-depth claims; the carry-matrix argument does.
Digit-two indicators, not the full output ternary digits, are independent.
The dimension is a 3-adic grid correlation dimension, not a Euclidean density theorem.
Earlier unindexed or implicitly equivalent analysis may exist; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_integrity.scope: The distribution of X+2Y in the 3-adic integers for independent fair {0,1}-digit Cantor variables, and finite congruence modulo 3^k.

title: A full-support singular ternary Cantor convolution with an exact collision law
